knowledge:
- key_parameters: transformation=Specifies whether to linearize (default), scale to [0,1], or apply PnG scaling to FCS data during read ;; alter.names=Logical indicating whether to convert parameter names into R-friendly equivalents (e.g., replacing "-" with ".") ;; column.pattern=Regular expression to filter and read only a subset of parameters matching the pattern ;; which.lines=Numeric vector specifying a sample of lines/events to read from a large FCS file ;; stain_match=Specifies how to match singly-stained control files to channels in spillover ("ordered" or "regexpr")
- alternatives: ggcyto=Preferred for advanced visualization and ggplot2 integration ;; flowStats=Preferred for automated spillover matrix calculation and normalization ;; openCyto=Preferred for automated gating algorithms (e.g., mindensity, singletGate) ;; flowWorkspace=Preferred for managing hierarchical gating trees via GatingSet and GatingHierarchy
- when_to_use: Use when importing raw FCS files (versions 2.0 through 3.1) into R to perform standard flow cytometry preprocessing, including spectral compensation, log/logicle/biexponential transformations, and manual or automated gating.
- pitfalls: stain_match="ordered" in spillover assumes singly-stained control files are in the exact order of the channel columns, which can lead to incorrect compensation matrices if they are out of order; use "regexpr" or spillover_match instead ;; When reading list mode data with unused bits (e.g., 10-bit ADC stored in 16-bit space), implementors must use a bit mask to avoid reading erroneous values from the unused bits ;; Using fsApply with use.exprs=TRUE passes the raw expression matrix instead of the flowFrame object, which will cause functions expecting S4 flowFrame metadata to fail.

workflows.name: flow_cytometry_preprocessing
workflows.intent: Read FCS files, calculate and apply spectral compensation, transform fluorescence channels, and apply manual gates to filter populations.
input: fcs.dir (directory containing single-stained compensation control FCS files)
comp_match.csv (CSV file matching control filenames to channels)
workflows.stages: 1. Read FCS files into flowFrame or flowSet ;; 2. Calculate or load the spillover matrix ;; 3. Compensate the spectral overlap ;; 4. Transform parameters using log or logicle scales ;; 5. Define and apply gates (filtering) to isolate cell populations
workflows.code:
file.name <- system.file("extdata","0877408774.B08", 
                         package="flowCore")
x <- read.FCS(file.name, transformation=FALSE)
summary(x)
keyword(x,c("$P1E", "$P2E", "$P3E", "$P4E"))
summary(read.FCS(file.name))
summary(read.FCS(file.name,transformation="scale")) 
read.FCS(file.name,alter.names=TRUE) 
x <- read.FCS(file.name, column.pattern="-H") 
lines <- sample(100:500, 50)
y <- read.FCS(file.name, which.lines = lines) 
fcs.dir <- system.file("extdata",
                       "compdata",
                       "data",
                       package="flowCore")
frames <- lapply(dir(fcs.dir, full.names=TRUE), read.FCS)
fs <- as(frames, "flowSet")
names(frames) <- sapply(frames, keyword, "SAMPLE ID")
fs <- as(frames, "flowSet")
phenoData(fs)$Filename <- fsApply(fs,keyword, "$FIL")
fs <- read.flowSet(path = fcs.dir)
fsApply(fs, each_col, median)
comp_list <- spillover(x)
comp  <- comp_list[[1]]
x_comp <- compensate(x, comp)
comp <- fsApply(fs, function(x) spillover(x)[[1]], simplify=FALSE)
fs_comp <- compensate(fs, comp)
transList <- estimateLogicle(x, c("V450-A","V545-A"))
frames <- lapply(dir(fcs.dir, full.names=TRUE), read.FCS)
names(frames) <- c("UNSTAINED", "FL1-H", "FL2-H", "FL4-H", "FL3-H")
frames <- as(frames, "flowSet")
comp <- spillover(frames, unstained="UNSTAINED", patt = "-H",
                  fsc = "FSC-H", ssc = "SSC-H", 
                  stain_match = "regexpr")
comp_match <- system.file("extdata", "compdata", "comp_match",
                          package="flowCore")
matched_fs <- spillover_match(path=control_path, 
                              fsc = "FSC-H", ssc = "SSC-H", 
                              matchfile = comp_match)
comp <- spillover(matched_fs, fsc = "FSC-H", ssc = "SSC-H", 
                  prematched = TRUE)
transform(fs[[1]],
                   `FL1-H`=log(`FL1-H`),
                   `FL2-H`=log(`FL2-H`)
                   )
aTrans <- truncateTransform("truncate at 1", a=1)
transform(fs,`FL1-H`=aTrans(`FL1-H`))
myTrans <- transformList('FL1-H', aTrans)
transform(fs, myTrans)
rectGate <- rectangleGate(filterId="Fluorescence Region", 
                          "FL1-H"=c(0, 12), "FL2-H"=c(0, 12))
result = filter(fs[[1]],rectGate)
summary(result)
filter(fs,rectGate)
morphGate <- norm2Filter("FSC-H", "SSC-H", filterId="MorphologyGate", 
                         scale=2)
smaller <- Subset(fs, morphGate)
split(smaller[[1]], kmeansFilter("FSC-H"=c("Low","Medium","High"),
                                 filterId="myKMeans"))
rectGate & morphGate
rect2 <- rectangleGate(filterId="Another Rect", "FL1-H"=c(1,2), 
"FL2-H"=c(2,3)) %on% tFilter

workflows.name: gatingset_hierarchical_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform hierarchical gating and population analysis using GatingSet, GatingHierarchy, and automated gating functions.
workflows.stages: 1. Create a GatingSet from a flowSet ;; 2. Apply spectral compensation ;; 3. Transform channels using biexponential or logicle scales ;; 4. Add gates hierarchically to the GatingSet ;; 5. Recompute the gating tree ;; 6. Extract population statistics and subset data
workflows.code:
gs <- GatingSet(fs)
comp
gs <- compensate(gs, comp)
fs_comp <- getData(gs)
biexpTrans <- flowJo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=262144
                          , pos=4.5,neg=0, widthBasis=-10)
chnls <- parameters(comp)
tf <- transformerList(chnls, biexpTrans)
gs <- transform(gs, tf)
rg1 <- rectangleGate("FSC-A"=c(50000, Inf), filterId="NonDebris")
gs_pop_add(gs, rg1, parent = "root")
recompute(gs)
gh_pop_get_stats(gs[[1]], "NonDebris")
mat <- matrix(c(54272,59392,259071.99382782
                ,255999.994277954,62464,43008,70656
                ,234495.997428894,169983.997344971,34816)
              , nrow = 5)
colnames(mat) <-c("FSC-A", "FSC-H")
pg <- polygonGate(mat)
gs_pop_add(gs, pg, parent = "NonDebris", name = "singlets")
rg2 <- rectangleGate("V450-A"=c(2000, Inf))
gs_pop_add(gs, rg2, parent = "singlets", name = "CD3")
qg <- quadGate("B710-A" = 2000, "R780-A" = 3000)
gs_pop_add(gs, qg, parent="CD3", names = c("CD8", "DPT", "CD4", "DNT"))
recompute(gs, "singlets")
fs_nonDebris <- getData(gs, "NonDebris")
gs_pop_get_count_fast(gs)
Rm('CD3', gs)
